impl.summary:
Implemented the "Existing site" migration mode for the importer (plugin heartland-k9s-core 1.1.0) so the live heartlandk9s.org install can be migrated in place: install plugin + theme, activate, tick/confirm "Existing site: adopt matching content", dry run, import.

What was built:
1. Mode flag `mode.adopt` (admin checkbox `#hk9-import-adopt`, CLI `--adopt-existing`, REST `start.adopt`), persisted in the run state and log header; a new `adopt` action counted per step (admin "Adopt" column, CLI `adopt` column, log lines `ADOPT #<id> …`; sensitive records log `sensitive#<hash> ADOPT #<id>` only).
2. Adoption rules in the new read-only matcher `Import\Adopt`: `live:page:<id>` by id (slug must match; id-exists-but-slug-differs warns and falls back to slug), any page record by `get_page_by_path()` of its slug/path, `live:barkode:<id>` → the PAGE with that id/slug converted in place (`_wp_page_template` removed, `post_type` → hk9_barkode, `clean_post_cache`; pre-image post_type/template recorded), `live:media:<id>` by id + basename of `_wp_attached_file`/`original_image` + file exists (sha256 index stays the fallback; attachment kept as-is, hashes recorded from the DB), terms/menus by slug/name (now reported as adopt). Never trashed posts, never posts bound to another key (`Map::bound_post_key`), never non-pages converted. Adopted rows: `created_by_run = NULL`, new column `adopted_by_run` (Map DB_VERSION 2, dbDelta). First bind applies title/status/template/excerpt/menu_order/parent/featured/meta/terms/content unconditionally with pre-images (id/slug/date/author kept via `PostFields::for_adopted`; a record without a content file blanks the old Avada content). Dry runs remember `dry_adopted` so hierarchy/content/media_sizes/redirect-shadow checks report the real outcome. The core Privacy Policy placeholder adoption is untouched and does not conflict.
3. Rollback: pre-images restored (PostFields now knows `post_type` and treats absent meta as null → restoring null deletes the key, so a converted record returns to a page without registry meta), then rows adopted by that run are **un-adopted** (row + `_hk9_source_key`/`_hk9_import_run`/`_hk9_import_pending` dropped, object kept) — reported as `unadopted` in CLI/admin. Created menus now keep their `location:*` pre-image so theme locations return to the previous menus.
4. Pre-flight (`Import\Preflight`, admin card "2. Pre-flight", `GET hk9/v1/import/preflight?path=`, `wp hk9 preflight [<dir>] [--format=json]`): PHP ≥ 8.1, WP ≥ 6.4, active theme (with Appearance → Themes link), pretty permalinks, uploads writable, payload + counts, "Existing content detected" (unmapped page/registry/media matches computed from the manifest; pre-ticks the adopt checkbox when > 0) plus a "Next steps" checklist after a completed real run (verify front page/menus, deactivate Avada Builder/Core/FooGallery/FooBox, review docs/unresolved.md, delete a server-path payload).
5. Two importer bugs surfaced by the simulation and fixed: (a) a pre-existing attachment whose slug equals a new page's slug (`about.jpg` → `about`) made WordPress publish the About page as `about-2` and hand `/about/` to the file — posts_hierarchy now renames such attachments to `media-<slug>` before publishing (dry runs warn) and warns whenever a stored slug still differs; (b) `Reconcile::readback` now refreshes the `db` hash of every non-conflicting field, so a side-effect slug change no longer produces a phantom conflict on re-runs.
6. Docs: docs/install.md §B rewritten as the client runbook (backup, plugin+theme install, SFTP payload, pre-flight → adopt → dry run → import, what happens to pages/registry/media/menus/front page/settings, after-import plugin deactivation, Slim SEO note (theme compat verified in inc/compat.php), delete payload, rollback); docs/importer.md §2.1/2.2/§3/§4/§7/§8/§10.1; ARCHITECTURE §8 note; STATUS entry.
7. Version bumped to 1.1.0. Local site left populated by a fresh real-payload import; tools/url-matrix.sh passes (81 rows).

issues: Other, unrelated working-tree changes appeared in the repo while I worked (docs/admin-guide.md, plugin Forms/Sections/Settings/Notices, theme forms/GF SCSS + dist CSS, docker/fixtures/hk9-tmp-gf-setup.php, src/Admin/EditorGuidance.php, src/Support/FormProviders.php, tools/kinsta-wp.sh) — another session is editing forms/Gravity Forms work concurrently. I did not touch those files; because the plugin is bind-mounted they were live during my test runs (all suites still passed, debug.log stayed empty).

Deviation from the letter of rule 2c: an attachment record marked `sensitive` still gets its generic title / empty alt applied on adoption (pre-image kept) instead of keeping the live title, to honour the registry-privacy design (F7). The real payload has 0 sensitive attachment records, so this never triggers today.
On the first run of the simulation I edited the suite script while bash was executing it, which corrupted that run (bash reads scripts incrementally); the reported results are from clean re-runs.

Not implemented (outside the requested rules): adopting an already-converted hk9_barkode record or another same-type post by slug when the map has been lost — only pages are matched/converted. A stale hk9_barkode with the same slug would still yield a -2 record.
dist/*.zip and SHA256SUMS were not rebuilt for 1.1.0 (npm run package) — packaging was not part of the task; docs/verification.md still cites 1.0.2 as the verified build.
Menu-location restore on rollback only covers locations of the theme active at rollback time; on the real site Avada's own nav_menu_locations live in theme_mods_Avada and are untouched anyway.
impl.integration_notes: Branch build/wordpress-conversion, nothing committed (per instructions). Map table gains column `adopted_by_run` (Map::DB_VERSION '2'; Map::ensure() upgrades in place via dbDelta on first use — a fresh install creates it on activation). REST `start` accepts `adopt`; new route `GET hk9/v1/import/preflight[?path=]` (manage_options + nonce; path validated like start). Per-step counts now carry an `adopt` key — anything parsing the CLI summary table should look columns up by header (tests/importer-suite.sh count() already does). Rollback report has a new `unadopted` array (State::mark_rolled_back counts it; CLI/JS print it). Reconcile::readback now refreshes db hashes of all non-conflicting fields (behavioural change for every step, verified by both suites). posts_hierarchy renames attachments that hold a page's slug at the same level to `media-<slug>` before publishing — attachment pages are off (wp_attachment_pages_enabled=0) so this is invisible. To re-run the simulation: bash plugin/heartland-k9s-core/tests/adopt-existing-suite.sh (LOCAL ONLY — it empties the site); afterwards re-populate with bash tools/reset-local-site.sh && tools/wp.sh hk9 import /var/www/html/wp-content/hk9-payload --user=admin. Client runbook: docs/install.md §B; internals: docs/importer.md §2.1–2.2, §10.1.

review.verdict: Sound overall — the adoption mode does what the report claims and I found no data-loss bug in the exercised paths (ids/slugs/dates kept, pre-images complete incl. post_type/template/parent/status/excerpt/menu_order/featured/meta/terms/content, conflicts detected on later runs, PII withheld in logs/state). Simulation re-run: 122 passed / 0 failed; url-matrix 81/81 after the final real import; debug.log empty. Two medium items should be fixed before the live run (converted-record re-adoption gap; Avada plugins active during the writes is untested), plus several low items, mostly docs/pre-flight accuracy.

findings.issue: post_candidate() only ever matches PAGES. A registry page already converted to hk9_barkode whose map row is missing (crash between the conversion wp_update_post() and Map::bind() in PostsStub::adopt_existing, a Map truncate/reset, or a plugin re-install) can never be re-adopted: probe on #2910 after deleting its row returned id=0 + warning, so the next run creates '<slug>-2' and the original converted post is left as an orphaned hk9_barkode with its _wp_page_template already deleted (that meta is also lost when the conversion wp_update_post() fails, because delete_post_meta runs first and the fail path only does Map::delete).
findings.fix: In post_candidate(), accept a post at the live id (or at the slug via get_posts post_type=$type) whose post_type === the record type and post_name === slug as a match with convert=false (also fixes the implementer's noted 'stale hk9_barkode' gap). In PostsStub::adopt_existing(), snapshot the template value before delete_post_meta() and re-add it (update_post_meta) when wp_update_post() returns WP_Error.

findings.issue: §B.2 step 3 instructs the client to keep Avada Builder, Avada Core, FooGallery and FooBox ACTIVE while the importer runs wp_update_post()/wp_insert_post() on 46 adopted pages and 250 attachments; the fixture (tests/adopt-existing-oldsite.php) contains none of those plugins, so their save_post / wp_insert_post_data / content filters and Fusion 'page options' meta handling are completely untested on the exact writes the migration makes. Nothing needs them once the theme is switched.
findings.fix: Move 'deactivate Avada Builder, Avada Core, FooGallery, FooBox' from B.5 to B.2 (before the import) and make the Next-steps/pre-flight text consistent; optionally add a pre-flight 'warn' line listing active plugins matching fusion-builder/fusion-core/foogallery/foobox.

findings.issue: The shared-by-sha256 loop (Map::rows_by_sha) runs BEFORE Adopt::attachment_candidate(), so for the 10 byte-identical live pairs (e.g. live:media:2149 + 2806) the second live attachment is never adopted: verified with a reset site holding both at their live paths — dry run logged '2149 ADOPT by id' and '2806 SKIP would share the attachment bound to live:media:2149'. 10 live attachments stay unbound duplicates and {{media:...}} for those keys resolve to the other id; docs/importer.md ('a live:media:<id> record first adopts the attachment with that id') and install.md ('same ids') overstate.
findings.fix: For live:media:* keys call Adopt::attachment_candidate() before the rows_by_sha loop (share only when the id match fails), or document that the second of each identical pair is bound to the first.

findings.issue: existing() counts every live:media id that exists as a non-trashed attachment (plain SQL) without the basename/file-exists rule, and includes both halves of identical pairs, so 'N attachment(s) would be adopted' can exceed what the run adopts (probe: preflight said 2, run adopted 1).
findings.fix: Use Adopt::attachment_candidate() per key (cheap — no hashing) so the count uses the real rule.

findings.issue: Slug/path matching uses get_page_by_path() with only a 'trash' exclusion, so a private/pending/draft page (with a stored slug) that happens to hold a record slug is adopted and then published with payload content on first bind (probe: private page → id matched, how=slug). Not a live-site problem today, but a silent visibility change with no warning.
findings.fix: Warn (dry run) when the matched page is not 'publish', or restrict the slug rule to publish/draft.

findings.issue: Attachment adoption by id + basename never checks bytes; a live file replaced in place under the same name (Enable Media Replace etc.) is adopted silently even though _hk9_sha256 from Validate::prehash is available at that point.
findings.fix: When _hk9_sha256 exists and differs from record sha256, log a warning ('file bytes differ from payload; adopted as-is') so the audit trail shows it.

findings.issue: No content-freeze note: on the first bind adopted pages are overwritten unconditionally (by design), so any edit made on heartlandk9s.org after the payload snapshot (2026-09-11) is lost except via wholesale rollback. Also the old registry page content (handler/veteran details) stays in hk9_import_map.before_data and in the pages' existing revisions after conversion — needed for rollback but should be purged after sign-off; and importer.md says 'nothing is written to the attachment' although _hk9_source_key/_hk9_sha256 meta are added.
findings.fix: Add to §B.1: 'do not edit pages/media on the live site after <payload date>; re-apply such edits after the import'; add to §B.5: after sign-off, delete old revisions of the 16 records and the import map rows/before_data; adjust the 'nothing is written' sentence.

fix.summary: Applied every finding from the review (2 medium, 5 low). Code: (1) Adopt::post_candidate() now also matches a post that already IS the record type (hk9_barkode) at the live id or at the slug (get_posts by name) with convert=false, and returns the matched post_type; a matched page whose status differs from the record's carries a warning (finding 5); PostsStub::adopt_existing() snapshots the raw _wp_page_template before delete_post_meta() and re-adds it when the conversion wp_update_post() fails (post still a page), and counts/logs ADOPT only after a successful conversion (a failed conversion is a fail, not adopt+fail). (3) MediaFiles: in adopt mode Adopt::attachment_candidate() runs BEFORE the rows_by_sha loop, so both halves of a byte-identical live pair (e.g. 2149+2806) are adopted by their own id; the dry-run "would share" verdict now compares the would-be owner's adopted id instead of assuming any same-sha match is shared. (6) When the live attachment's known sha256 (_hk9_sha256 meta, or the dry-run prehash state) differs from the record's, a warning "file bytes differ from the payload … adopted as-is" is logged. (4) Preflight::existing() counts attachments with Adopt::attachment_candidate() (real rule, no hashing) and counts a registry record as registry by record type (also when already converted). (2) New pre-flight check "Legacy builder plugins" (warn + Plugins link naming active plugins whose dir is fusion-builder/fusion-core/foogallery/foobox*, never blocks); admin Next-steps text now says the plugins were deactivated before the import. Docs: install.md B.2 step 3 deactivates Avada Builder/Core/FooGallery/FooBox BEFORE the import (B.5 now "delete once happy"), B.1 content-freeze note (snapshot 2026-09-11), B.4 pre-flight line, media table row (duplicated uploads keep both ids; bytes-mismatch warning), B.5 step 7 post-sign-off purge of record revisions + import-map before_data (verified WP-CLI one-liners), B.6 note; importer.md §2 media_files/posts_stub rows, §2.1 matching table (re-adoption row, failed-conversion behaviour, status warning, sha warning, "nothing is written" corrected to name the marker meta), §2.2 pre-flight (plugin check, real rules), §10/§10.1 updated to the new fixture and 155 checks; ARCHITECTURE.md §8 paragraph; STATUS.md count. Tests: fixture adds the byte-identical live pair 2149 (2020/03) + 2806 (2022/12); suite adds a failed-conversion probe (tests/adopt-existing-convert-fail.php, forces wp_insert_post_empty_content in a throw-away Context), a stub FooGallery plugin pre-flight warn check, pair-specific assertions, and a step 7 crash-window re-adoption scenario (map row + marker of live:barkode:2910 deleted while it stays hk9_barkode → adopt 1 / create 0, no -2 duplicate, re-run skips). Suites: adopt-existing 155/155, importer 81/81; php -l clean; local site reset and re-imported with the real payload (30 pages, 240 attachments, 16 records), url-matrix 81/81, debug.log 0 bytes, real-payload dry run reports skip everywhere. No git commit/checkout/stash/reset performed.

issues: Finding 7 (purge of pre-images/revisions after sign-off) is implemented as documented WP-CLI one-liners in install.md B.5 step 7, not as an admin button; nulling before_data makes a later rollback of that run un-adopt without restoring (documented).

For sensitive (registry) records the new log detail '(already converted; binding restored)' and the conversion-failure message are withheld as designed — only 'sensitive#<hash> ADOPT #<id>' / '(details withheld)' appear; the suite's probe therefore checks the withheld state message rather than the text.

Pre-existing, not changed: the redirect record keys themselves (e.g. 'redirect:/larry-and-archie-service-k9/') appear verbatim in the run log at the redirects step — they are public URL paths (the printed QR routes), not registry data, but note it if log contents are ever considered sensitive.

The legacy-plugin pre-flight check matches by plugin directory slug (fusion-builder, fusion-core, foogallery, foobox*); a plugin installed under a renamed directory would not be flagged. The check is a Note and never blocks the run.

Bytes of a live attachment matched by id are still not compared for the match itself (by design, no hashing); the new warning relies on the validate prehash (real runs write _hk9_sha256 before media_files; dry runs use state.prehash, where a duplicate-sha id overwritten by a later id may go unwarned in the dry run only).
The working tree already carried many uncommitted modifications from earlier work on this branch; my edits are on top of them and nothing was committed, stashed, checked out or reset.
fix.integration_notes: Behaviour changes to be aware of: (a) in adopt mode a live:media:<id> record is now bound to its own live attachment even when another record has identical bytes — the 9 live pairs in the real payload become 18 separate adoptions on heartlandk9s.org (only ref:asset:heartland-k9s-logo still shares #3028); (b) Adopt::post_candidate() returns an extra 'post_type' element and may return a non-empty warning for an id match (status mismatch); (c) Preflight adds a check with id 'legacy_plugins' (status pass|warn) — the admin JS and CLI render it generically, no JS change needed; the 'existing.media' count now uses Adopt::attachment_candidate() and 'existing.registry' counts by record type; (d) PostsStub counts/logs ADOPT after a successful conversion (dry runs unchanged); (e) the fixture now creates 6 attachments (adds 2149 at 2020/03 and 2806 at 2022/12), so suite expectations moved to media adopt 6 / create 235 / 241 total / 33 ADOPT lines / 16 un-adopted. The adopt suite empties the local site; it was reset and re-populated with a clean non-adopt import of the real payload at the end (map rows are 'created', as before). New test helper tests/adopt-existing-convert-fail.php is local-only (refuses without HK9_LOCAL_DEV) and removes its own log file.
